card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a drug name is expected, such as "such as", "dosages of", "components of", and commas in drug lists. Also some digits and hyphens inside numbers and terms.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: "as" or "of" or a comma right before a named drug or drug list.

modes.label: Partway through terms or numbers
modes.description: A hyphen, digit or word ending inside an HIV term, a minute count or a section number.
